mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park, and a full moon will be visible tonight.

The City of Verona reports that Highway M will undergo a closure for construction starting October 5, and residents should also be aware of a scam alert regarding fake emails requesting payment for planning application fees.
There is a great lineup today including the Verona Fall Fest and live music at Bailey's Run, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market happening tomorrow.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary incident at Hunters Cove Way involving a 19-year-old suspect who was apprehended after a shot was fired.
Today at Culver's, the location is closed for a scheduled remodel, but you can look forward to OREO REESE'S Cheesecake as tomorrow's flavor when they open at 10 AM.
